newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune buy reiterated.

text.p: --Prudential Securities Inc said it strongly reiterated a buy rating on Tribune Co. Analyst Melissa Cook in a report on Thursday said the stock "remains our single best idea."
--The analyst raised her pro forma earnings per share estimate for 1997 to $2 from $1.95 to include the media company's pending acquisition of Renaissance as of February 1.
--Prudential also issued a preliminary 1998 estimate of $2.30 a share and a 1998-based (12 to 18 month) price target of $57 for Tribune's stock.
